task: regression — log flame burn duration (s) of SPICE co-flow smoke-point tests

dataset.target: ln(1 + burn duration seconds), burn duration = GMT Flame Off − GMT ignition

validation: GroupKFold n=4 grouped by GMT test date
limitations: Burn duration is derived from operator-logged GMT timestamps; timestamp resolution and logging practice vary.
Duplicate timestamps appear in the source (replicate records) — grouped validation mitigates but does not eliminate overlap effects.
Applicability domain limited to SPICE fuels/nozzles/flow ranges; extrapolation unsupported.
statusDetail: Neither ridge nor gradient boosting beats the per-fuel mean-duration baseline under grouped (by-date) validation. Honest conclusion: pre-test features in this table do not generalise across test dates for burn duration. Retained for transparency and future re-evaluation; NOT offered as a predictor in the UI playground.
